name: Fanbase
summary: A maker's profile card whose Follow button pops hearts, rolls the count and opens suggestions
about: A creator profile card with an illustrated cover whose layers drift with your pointer and a spinning story ring round the avatar. Follow squashes the button, bursts hearts, rolls the follower count up by one and slides in a bell for post alerts, then a row of suggested makers glides out beside the card. Message opens a small composer with quick replies that sends a bubble and marks it Seen.
how: Press Follow: the button squashes and pops, hearts fly, the avatar ripples and the follower count rolls up.
A bell slides in next to it; press it to turn post alerts on or off.
Suggested makers slide out beside the card (under it on phones): follow them, or press the cross to swap in someone new.
Press Following to unfollow: a small confirm bar slides over the buttons, with Cancel and Unfollow (Escape cancels).
Press Message, tap a quick reply or type your own, then Send to see the bubble go out and turn Seen.
